entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand I bought. I expect a full refund, and I don't want any hassle about it. This is completely unacceptable.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's neither! It's an emergency! I bought this for my son, who's in the military, to use for his upcoming deployment. The day after it arrived, he ended up in the hospital and needed major surgery. He's been there for weeks!
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope your son has a fast and full recovery. Let me just pull up the order details. I see it was delivered about 30 days ago, is that right?
Yes, and if you're about to tell me I missed some stupid 10-day window because of a medical emergency, you can get your manager on the phone right now! I'm not playing games.

No, not at all, and I completely understand your concern. There's no need to worry. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor you purchased has a 10-day return policy. Since you're unfortunately outside that timeframe, I can approve a full refund for you right now.
Wait, what? Ninety days? Are you serious?

Yes, absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll get an email with a pre-paid shipping label shortly. Just send the item back in its box, and your refund will be issued as soon as we receive it.
Oh. Well... that's... that was easy. I was prepared for a fight. I apologize for my tone earlier.
It's completely understandable given everything you're dealing with. I'm just glad I could make this part simple for you. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's it. Thank you, Charlie. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome. Please send our best wishes to your son. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
